papers.rationale: Robot suitability allocation does not directly address specified topics; twelve methods are compared across common scenarios and robustness conditions.
Social reasoning is outside the filters; evaluation compares a robotics VLM against published baselines on real interaction data.
General manipulation benchmarking has only incidental connection to specific manipulation filters; abstract describes specifications without evaluated results.
Mobile manipulation and navigation enable autonomous brick stacking; repeated hardware assemblies and outdoor tests validate a proof of concept without comparative evaluation.
Disturbance-aware predictive flight control supports navigation; hardware experiments demonstrate improved prediction and trajectory tracking through online adaptation.
Action-influence data collection directly improves navigation world models; comparative simulated navigation and manipulation experiments quantify controllability and data efficiency.
Robot instruction safety does not address the specified filters; comparative arm trials evaluate harmful instructions and harmless controls with runtime checking.
Head stabilization workspace characterization falls outside the filters; a human volunteer investigation is described without comparative results.
Unified leg and thruster allocation centrally addresses whole-body control; simulations demonstrate allocation, while hardware validates mechanical viability and assisted trotting.
Radar geolocalization directly enables navigation; evaluation spans eight datasets, urban and offroad routes, and weather changes over thirteen months.
Visual corruption attribution for general arm manipulation does not directly address filters; comparative simulation and Franka experiments demonstrate attribution improvements.
Point cloud registration is an enabling perception technique with incidental navigation relevance; contribution is theoretical, with no described empirical evaluation.
Personalized exoskeleton guidance centrally addresses assisted navigation; human trials demonstrate path following and gait classification generalizes to unseen users.

Embodiment-aware trajectory generation centrally targets dexterous manipulation; comparative simulation demonstrates improved policies and transfer across two humanoid embodiments without generator retraining.
Depth estimation is broadly enabling for navigation but does not directly contribute navigation methods; nine model families receive comparative dataset benchmarking.
General compositional diffusion policies do not explicitly target any filter; multiple benchmark comparisons demonstrate specialization while preserving multitask performance.
Symbolic educational task planning has incidental relation to motion planning; implemented Nao execution is described without comparative or quantitative evaluation.
Adhesive contact-state sensing does not target dexterous manipulation or other filters; six models and an online state-machine enhancement are compared experimentally.
General spatial grounding does not directly address specified filters; seven public grounding benchmarks and controlled scaling comparisons evaluate performance.
Long-horizon task reasoning and geometric constraints are incidentally related to motion planning; benchmark specifications are provided without reported evaluation results.
High-level manipulation recovery replanning is incidentally related to motion planning; comparative benchmarks, ablations, and zero-shot transfer validate recovery improvements.
Dexterous grasp generation centrally addresses dexterous manipulation; comparative simulation, zero-shot finger-removal transfer, and one hundred real-robot trials validate the method.
Rig animation and video generation do not address robot motion planning or control; evaluations compare motion faithfulness against video-first pipelines.
Noise-aware planning centrally addresses navigation and motion planning; comparative multidimensional benchmarks show success and runtime gains in unseen geometries.
Collaborative scene understanding is an enabling perception component for navigation; benchmark comparisons show improvements over open-vocabulary single-agent approaches.
